decisions.reason: The warning must not interfere with the footer, but that impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY setting footer_interference_allowed to false.
Restoring the standard footer on page 4 does not change the independently specified internal-page header.
The footer-restoration decision does not change the existing RR-01 identifier rule or introduce a new identifier value.
The footer-interference decision does not alter which customer fields are editable or how those fields are displayed.
A page-4 footer correction does not change the front-page dashboard's fields, heading, or prominence.
The source footer decision does not change the content or presentation of the front-page result explanation.
Restoring the page-4 footer does not change the required fonts, icons, or reusable design assets for handoff.
The footer amendment does not change source-template editability, report variants, export support, or delivery format.
The footer correction has no effect on report-variant selection or risk and exposure band mapping.
Although footer consistency contributes to overall polish, the source decision does not change the candidate's existing visual-style or refinement-priority attributes.
